notes: Fixed navigation: the back button, menus, and panels all respond correctly again.
The app always loads the newest version when online, so changes like the simplified Settings arrive immediately instead of staying stuck on old cached screens.
Only one pen, guaranteed: the in-page pen is hidden on every load and the floating pen is the only one on screen.
The floating pen's quick capture now fits properly: its category chips scroll so none of them are cut off.
Tapping the floating pen reliably opens the quick capture popup.
Cleaner Settings, arranged into tidy cards: Account, Floating pen, Updates, Data, and Troubleshooting.
A single Check for update button with your current app version below it (the old sync-server fields and web-update check are gone).
Sessions start instantly, even offline. Enter book and author, tap Start (or press Enter), and a Reading banner appears while the session runs.
Notes show relative dates, a search icon was added, and empty screens are friendlier.
